primary.title: Will RBI’s new measures to support rupee affect overseas investments? Experts explain
primary.summary: The rupee surged 93 paise after the RBI tightened forex rules to curb dollar speculation. Experts explain how the measures could affect returns on US stocks, international mutual funds and ETFs, and what Indian investors should know about currency risk and overseas investments.
